findings.rule: Section 6(2) Ethics standard: 'Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words, and their adjectives.'
findings.problem: The title contains the word 'Novel', which is explicitly prohibited by journal policy.

findings.rule: Section 5(6) References: 'When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.'
findings.problem: Reference citations in the manuscript use parentheses (e.g., '(1, 2)') instead of the required square brackets.

findings.rule: Section 5(2) Tables & Section 5(3) Figures: 'All tables must be cited in the text.' / 'All figures must be cited in the text.'
findings.problem: Neither Table 1 nor Figure 1 is cited anywhere in the manuscript text.

findings.rule: Section 5(6) References: 'References should be numbered sequentially as they appear in the text... All references should be listed in numerical order...'
findings.problem: The reference list is not in numerical order (lists [1], [2], [3], [4], [7], [6], [8]) and citations in the text do not follow sequential appearance order.

findings.rule: Section 5(6) References: 'The use of “in preparation” and “submitted for publication” is not allowed in the Reference list.'
findings.problem: Reference [5] ends with 'In preparation.', which is explicitly prohibited.

findings.rule: Section 5(3) Figures: 'Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi resolution...' & 'We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats.'
findings.problem: The submitted figure is at 150 dpi (below the required 300 dpi) and uses the BMP format, which is not among the accepted formats.

findings.rule: Section 5(4) Supplementary materials: 'Do not include spaces or Japanese characters (multi-byte codes) in the file name or the file path: Please use alphanumeric characters only.' & 'As Supplementary materials, image files should be in PDF, TXT or ZIP format...'
findings.problem: The supplementary file name contains a Japanese character (図) and a space, violating the alphanumeric-only rule. Additionally, it uses the BMP format instead of the allowed PDF, TXT, or ZIP formats.
